visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses wearing a brown baseball cap and a white T-shirt speaks directly into the camera lens. Behind him, a woman with long dark hair sits on a beige sofa in a well-lit living room. Yellow 'CAUTION' tape graphics frame the screen edges at the top and bottom. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of a game board containing rows of red frames holding Harry Potter character portraits. Stylized gold text overlays reading 'Round 2' and 'Harry Potter' appear in the center of the frame against a blurred background. (3) Close-up shots of hands holding and flipping small blue and red cards depicting various characters. The woman's face appears in a circular inset in the corner as she observes the card selection. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a studio setting. (4) The two players sit at a grey table, engaged in the game. The woman wears a brown blazer and glasses, holding a clear water bottle with a small orange toy on the lid. The man reacts with wide eyes and laughter to her questions. (5) Animated graphics including mathematical equations and question marks float around the man's head as he concentrates. He points his finger while speaking. The background remains a bookshelf filled with numerous colorful books and decorative items. (6) The woman claps her hands and smiles broadly as she wins the round. Gold 'WINNER' stars and text appear over her. The final scene shows both characters discussing the next round with promotional text regarding a future broadcast date.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A loud, piercing megaphone siren or emergency alert sound triggers the start. A high-energy male voice speaks rapidly in Mandarin with high pitch and excitement. Upbeat, high-tempo electronic BGM with a 4/4 percussive beat and bright synth chords begins immediately. (2) A sharp, synthesized 'whoosh' transition sound occurs. The BGM maintains its tempo but introduces more melodic synth layers. A male voice, sounding authoritative and deep, announces 'Round 2' and 'Harry Potter' in English with significant reverb. (3) Quiet, high-frequency percussive 'click' sounds are heard as cards are manipulated. A female voice speaks in a calm, friendly tone in Mandarin, describing her game strategy. The BGM ducks slightly to allow the speech to be clearly audible. (4) A burst of canned laughter SFX plays, followed by the male speaker laughing loudly with high vocal arousal. The female speaker performs a short sentence in English with a exaggerated British accent. The BGM remains steady with a driving bassline. (5) Fast-paced vocal exchanges between the male and female speakers in English and Mandarin. Every few seconds, a bright 'ding' or digital 'pop' sound effect emphasizes a question or action. The audio density is high, with overlapping speech and music. (6) A sudden 'wrong answer' buzzer or low-frequency dissonant sound effect interrupts the flow. The music stops momentarily for comedic emphasis as the male speaker groans. A series of fast, percussive 'hit' SFX accompany a rapid sequence of events. (7) A final, triumphant 'ding' SFX and a swelling electronic synthesizer chord signal the end of the game. The female speaker cheers. The BGM reaches a climax in volume before a quick fade-out during the closing promotional announcement.
